svg.text: finbot: the whole system on one page
Request path top to bottom; stores, ingestion and governance underneath. Every box is Python in finbot/, infra/cdk or deploy/k8s.
WAF: per-IP rate, managed rules, 16 KB body
verify token (key ring by kid) and revocation (2 s) · deny-by-default roles
rate limit per user and tenant, shared counters across pods
tenant scope from the token · DLP in and out · cancel a running turn
same 403 for another tenant's session and a missing one
retry later on outage · DLQ after 5
forged tenant in a message → DLQ
Worker pool (runtime.py, worker_main.py) · stateless, KEDA on queue depth
claim lease (60 s) → load committed state → journal turn by msg_id → run → CAS commit
heartbeat before each model call · cancel flag checked there · late writer → StaleWrite
crash = nothing committed; next worker re-runs from the last commit (tools are read-only)
FINBOT_DISPATCH=queue: enqueue, poll for the commit, 202 if slow
record ids must come from the user
evidence · reason · domain status and cause · language · commitments · tickets
value provenance: facts only from our own fields · contacts and links checked
one repair → answer built from the record → "I won't guess" → person after 2
output guard (contextual grounding) · PII mask · prompt-leak canary
stale help page → note added by code
DLP on the way out; card data found → egress_leak
H# breaker health · C# control · R# counters
one line per turn and decision
Verified offline (scripted model, synthetic data): 475 tests · 8/8 multi-process durability scenarios (kill -9 mid-turn, frozen worker, lost reply,
32-turn memory across restarts, model failover, 6-process contention, guardrail outage, killed ingestion) · 0 of 2,259 injected hallucinations reach users ·
0 of 34 injection attacks succeed defended · never deployed, never run against a live model.
